models.name: SortWaste only · YOLO26 Medium · COCO-pretrained
models.description: Trained on SortWaste only from COCO weights. Evaluated materials: cardboard, metal and plastic; checkpoint defines seven labels.

models.name: SortWaste · YOLO + ResNet · post-trained
models.description: YOLO finds objects; the post-trained ResNet assigns six material labels. Cartons have no separate label.

models.name: TACO · YOLO + ResNet · post-trained
models.description: TACO YOLO finds objects; C4 ResNet was post-trained for 10 epochs on TACO training crops, with epoch 9 selected on validation. Six material labels.
